Venezuela Earthquakes Trigger Rescue Efforts and Political Frustration

Twin earthquakes in Venezuela have resulted in a significant death toll, with thousands injured and rescue operations continuing. Amidst the disaster, a man and a dog were found alive after being trapped for days. The earthquake response has also fueled public frustration, leading to calls for new presidential elections.
